phases.qa_focus: Sibling-lane architecture, no evidence-scan reopening, explicit retained-replay dependency posture, and diagnostics kept read-only.

phases.qa_focus: Undo not collapsed into replay, transaction-facing proof products explicit, and rollback residue classified honestly.
